description: Horizons barycentric ICRF states (m, m/s) of every body of the full set (planets and major moons, same order as solar-system-j2000.json 'bodies') at J2000 +-1, 10, 25 Julian years. t is seconds TDB from J2000.
source: JPL Horizons API (DE441 + JPL satellite ephemerides)
construction: Members of satellite systems (Earth-Moon, Jupiter..Pluto): DE441 system barycenter + Horizons state relative to that barycenter (as in solar-system-j2000.json, without the shift); the planet entry is the center of mass of the planet and its lumped inner moons (planetCenterSamples: the planet's center); other bodies: Horizons SSB-centred states.
